nodes.label: ADR-02: PostgreSQL Native Full-Text Search
nodes.rationale: For a hyperlocal directory capped at 5,000 to 10,000 listings, PostgreSQL FTS provides sub-10ms response times without cross-service network latency or extra SaaS costs.

nodes.label: ADR-04: Atomic Recalculation for Ratings & Review Aggregates
nodes.norm_label: adr-04: atomic recalculation for ratings & review aggregates
nodes.rationale: Recalculates ratings inside an atomic PostgreSQL interactive transaction when reviews change state to eliminate rating drift, stale averages, and race conditions.

nodes.label: ADR-01: Next.js App Router with Server Actions

nodes.rationale: A business directory lives and dies by SEO and TTFB. Server-rendering listing pages guarantees indexability and sub-second paint times. Server Actions eliminate redundant REST API routes and provide automatic CSRF protection.

nodes.rationale: Mitigates IDOR (OWASP Top 10 A01:2021) by enforcing tenant and ownership isolation directly in lib/services/ queries at the SQL level.
